fill.title: Three outcomes will tell Northwind the programme worked
fill.item1_body: Cut the close from 12 to 6 working days by the March 2027 year end.
fill.item2_body: Replace 38 feeder spreadsheets with a single consolidation model owned by group finance.
fill.item3_body: Free about 2 FTEs from reconciliations and put them on forecasting.

fill.title: We will judge each design choice against three tests
fill.item1_body: Every change maps to a step on the close calendar and the days it removes.
fill.item2_body: Finance owns each new process, with training before we hand over.
fill.item3_body: Controls are agreed with the external auditor before go-live.
